digest.component_or_area: tickets store initialization and CI checkout
propositions: Full clone of tickets store costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall-clock time; --filter=blob:none reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (~15x reduction)
In CI, actions/checkout fetch takes 237s whereas manual worktree mount takes 2s; partial clone via filter input since v4.1.0 can recover this gap
When remote fetch times out, rebar silently bootstraps an orphan branch producing an empty divergent store; fail-closed behavior is required instead
blob:none filter is safe for rebar's access patterns because verify-identity performs tree-level diff on local working tree, not lazy blob fetch
git blame over historical commits on the bug-close path (derive_caused_by) must abort on any per-path failure rather than tallying partial results to prevent incorrect caused_by links
Shallow clones (--depth) are unsafe because _is_enforced fails closed on git errors and would incorrectly enforce grandfathered events
